I would urgently alert the duty manager in writing that Alex’s box is on today’s destruction list despite an authorised collection booking for Wednesday, and that its contents are reportedly the only copies. I would ask whether there is any **authorised intervention** available before the 13:30 release deadline.

I would not change the storage date: the extension request is pending, not approved, and the next approval sitting is after the scheduled destruction. Nor would I promise Claire that the box will be available.

If no authorised intervention is arranged, I would release the full manifest as instructed, while documenting the escalation and outcome. That would mean the box is destroyed—a deeply regrettable and irreversible result—but the policy gives the desk operator no authority to grant the extension, and the manager has explicitly directed release of the full batch.
